slides.texte_overlay:
What young men should learn
before falling in love
Learn to handle your own emotions. Training, journaling, talking to friends. A partner shouldn't be the only place your feelings go.
Learn the difference between love and attachment. Love wants the other person to be free and happy. Attachment wants to control.
Learn to be honest early. About your plans, your past, what you want. Truth told early avoids pain later. Small truths build trust.
Learn to notice small needs. A tired face, a hard day, a quiet evening. Caring shows in details, not big speeches.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A curious mind makes you a much more interesting partner.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A curious mind makes you a much more interesting partner.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn that jealousy is not a sign of love. Trust is. Work on your insecurity instead of trying to control her life.
Learn to stay yourself. Keep your friends, sport and passions. The person she fell for should still be there a year later.
